title: typo wizard
pitch: spell words at monsters until autocorrect ruins your life. again.
controls: tap letter tiles or type on a keyboard to spell a word, tap cast or press enter. backspace removes a letter, space redraws.
how_to: spell a word from your 8 letter tiles (tap or type), then cast it at the monster.
longer words and rare letters hit harder: q z burn, x j freeze, k v crit, double letters shield.
read what the monster does next and its yellow quirk tag. pick fights, shops and rests between them.
beat 3 acts and their bosses, ending with autocorrect. the daily spell is the same 5 fights for everyone.
